arrow_draw.look: white hand-drawn curved stroke 0.6% H wide, round caps, small open arrowhead; curves from label to target

stamp.look: red #cb231e ALL CAPS slab/sans word inside a double rounded rectangle, eroded grunge texture, rotated -6..-8 deg

transfer_rules.spec: Start a new shot for every sentence that introduces a new subject/beat; 62% of shots contain exactly one sentence start, 29% none (continuation), 9% two. Target median shot 66 f (2.2 s), IQR 50-87 f, never <12 f.

Place the cut 3 f before the first word onset of the sentence (histogram mode -3; 95% of cuts fall 0-6 f before the next word); cuts land in the inter-sentence pause (median pause 17 f), only 17% inside a word.
~21.6 hard cuts/min; long holds (up to 13.7 s) only for emotional beats with no narration.
Every proper noun, number, time jump or punchline word gets an on-screen element; first frame = word onset + 0..5 f (median +4; tags +5, labels +3.5, stamps +5, bubbles +1, list items 0).

Character introduced -> name_tag (NAME + 1-3 word descriptor); time jump / rating -> gold outlined label; judgement / outcome word (TROUBLE, SAVED, MASSACRE, RAT) -> red stamp; quoted line -> speech bubble; enumerations -> list items or polaroid sets; numbers -> counter.

Tags/labels/bubbles: underdamped spring (omega0 0.61-0.72 rad/f, zeta 0.54-0.57) from ~0.35-0.5 scale, 13-15% overshoot at +4..+5 f, settled at +7..+9 f; rotation linear from -8..-12 deg to -2..0 deg. Stamps: 2 ghost frames at 1.5-1.8x, slam at +2, settled +3.
When the label is not adjacent to its referent, a white arrow draws on 3-4 f after the label appears, 10 f long.
No SFX on tags/labels/bubbles/arrows; SFX only on stamps (thump at slam), stamped icons, counters (ticks), polaroids (shutter), chapter cards (boom + new music cue), flashes and diegetic action.

transfer_rules.rule: Music is a bed, not a metronome
transfer_rules.spec: Cuts are not beat-aligned (25% within +-2 f of a beat vs 27% chance). Music sits ~14.6 LU under the voice, ducks ~3 dB under speech, changes cue every 10-30 s at section/mood changes, and drops out for 0.5-1.5 s before a punchline.

Every shot gets a slow push-in on the foreground layer (median 1-2 %/s, background 5-10x slower); when the narration enumerates or names a detail, punch in fast (7 f easeOut, x1.4) and nudge 4 f before each item.
Insert a chapter card at each life stage (every 30-70 s after the prologue): 72 f fade-through-black template, title = 1-3 words; next narration begins as the scene fades up.

Frame 0 = hero portrait already moving; first word at 0.4 s; title lower-left 2 f before the name; first cut at 2.3 s; 3 enumerated deeds with stamped list; open loop question answered much later ("Not a bullet, a cough").
Plant 2-3 running devices early (Remember-that-hat; THINGS TO REMEMBER list; plan tally) and revisit each 3-6 times, paying off at the end.
Subscribe scroll at ~1:48 (19% in), comment prompt at ~3:41 (40% in), end screen in the last 9 s asking a question + "Which character should be born next?".
Words: ~155 wpm, 7-word median sentences; between-sentence pause median 18 f (IQR 16-30); within-sentence pauses ~2 f.

Anchors = word onsets/offsets, sentence starts, pauses >= 300 ms, emphasised words (top-20% loudness or pitch peak within sentence), proper nouns, numbers, section boundaries; never use absolute frames.
